reviews.text: Best pet store in Philadelphia! So happy they carry Prinal raw food for my kitties. I have to go way across town, but it's worth supporting a lovely local small business!
What I truly love about this pet shop is that the workers are always very polite and friendly and they’re soo sweet to the pets that comes in and out of their shop

Excellent pet store with a wide range of food, toys, and accessories for dogs and cats. The staff are friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to suggest the right products. The store is clean and pets are well cared for. Prices are reasonable compared to others in the area. A great place for pet lovers looking for quality items and good service.
Great selection and usually cats for adoption in the front window.

I am sorry we weren't able to meet expectations or provide a great experience while shopping for your loved ones. If there is anything we can do to improve your experience in the shoppe, we would be happy to try to help!
Great selection, helpful staff

This review is well overdue as Fairmount Pet Shoppe is an institution for the area. Well stocked and fairly priced - they always had what we needed for our cats. Similarly, I'm very impressed with their consistent cat adoption process and partnership with Green Street Rescue. It's good people doing important work for a great part of the city. 5/5.
convenient and friendly service
Staff was very attentive and helpful!
They helped us get specific items we needed and even recommended another helpful item
They had what I needed (a very small cone) and were happy to help with my other odd request, cat clothes!
The people here are so helpful. They've special-ordered items for me and help me figure out what I need, however I still feel free to take my time and browse without pressure
Really nice and helpful especially when I had questions about my 3 wk old kitten.

Just moved to the area and we’ve officially made this our go-to store for cat food, treats, toys, etc. They’re extremely friendly here, have a few kitties walking around at all times, and also has some cats at the front of the store to adopt! Prices are extremely fair, consistent with bigger stores like Petco and PetSmart! Can’t go wrong with supporting small local businesses :)
Love this place.  Great service and a great small business.  They have everything you need in a small space.
Great service. Great selection.

It is such a nice little place to go to. They always have what I need and rarely are they out of stock of it. The staff is so friendly and helpful! The prices are very decent as well. I would highly recommend 👍 …

This was my first time at Fairmount Pet Shoppe and I was incredibly impressed with their selection! I tend to go to larger retail stores as my cats both require very specific foods, but they’ve since closed all of them within a 20 minute radius. I decided to pop in since they’re about 5 minutes away and they had both specialty foods I needed at an amazingly affordable price. The employees and customers were very kind and you could tell the employees have a relationship with their regulars. If there is something you need that they don’t have, they also offer to special order it! I’ll definitely be discontinuing my Petco membership and coming here instead.
Also, the dogs and cats they have are SO cute and well socialized!

Very friendly staff, both the human staff and the cat staff. The staff was very informative and helpful. Great selection of pet supplies despite the small store size. And the cats up for adoption in the window are cute.
We adore our local pet store! The nicest people and it's our dog's favorite place too!

I haven't been back to collect the soft carrier strap that I forgot to go back for, but they were great in my quest for small Pet Shoppe in the corporate boycott jawn.
It'll be them or Baltimore from now on
This store has a wonderfully curated selection of cat toys and accessories.

I call the store and I was asking questions about some fish meds, and she quickly says "we don't have it" and I'm like do you have anything that is similar and she says something, she spells it out for me and says. Good luck finding that and hangs up. It's a constant thing in Philadelphia, they hire people with no people skills and have no manners. Why are you in customer service if you don't know how to talk to customers? Oh and they all have one thing in common too! 🤔🤔🤔
Very cute, well priced, and incredible variety and selection for such a small shop.

I am a independent dog walk & pet sitter for the past 11 years. When my part time babies come to stay with me, they know that they get to eat all of the most delicious, smelliest, kinda grossest stuff they aren’t usually allowed to have at home. I’ve shopped online, bulk stores, and you will NOT find a better selection of all natural chews and treats at a more affordable price then at Fairmount Pet Shoppe! Dog food, supplements, toys, jackets, all cat items as mentioned above. Even small animal! They have a freezer if you are feeding raw. Call ahead and they will special order! FPS I a small locally run business that is exactly what everybody is looking for! Phenomenal customer service, Greeted when you enter the door, recommendations should you need any. The owner is the sweetest woman in the world and you’ll see after meeting the staff, any the money you save, why you’ll keep going back. Don’t see what you want? Ask if they can order it! You won’t be disappointed!
My favorite
Cute neighborhood pet shop with a surprisingly robust selection of stock for the space they have. They can also special order specific items for you even if they don't normally carry it in store.

I tried the goat's milk treat, but they didn't accept it, although they liked the food.

The place is small, nothing special, but 4 stars for the sake of the kitten.
Finally, I saw a kitten in this area!
Perfect having this in the neighborhood!
Amazing pet store. Staff is warm, friendly and helpful. Fairmount is lucky to have this place!
